shortDescription: Resource module for Sda Port Channels

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: connectedDeviceType
options.description: ConnectedDeviceType query parameter. Connected device type of the port channel. The allowed values are TRUNK, EXTENDED_NODE.

options.name: fabricId
options.description: FabricId query parameter. ID of the fabric the device is assigned to.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. ID of the port channel.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId query parameter. ID of the network device.

options.name: portChannelIds
options.description: PortChannelIds query parameter. IDs of the port channels to be selectively deleted(Maximum number of IDs this parameter could consume is 10).

options.name: portChannelName
options.description: PortChannelName query parameter. Name of the port channel.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
